outcomes.refused: The organization's rules did not allow that. Check the details and try again, or message the organization.
outcomes.notFound: That item is no longer open to you. Reload the page to see what is current.
outcomes.conflict: That already exists. Reload the page to see it.
outcomes.invalid: Some details are not in the expected format. Check each field and try again.
outcomes.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

refusals.application_deadline_passed: The deadline for this opportunity has passed, so it no longer takes applications. Explore for open ones.
refusals.opportunity_not_available: This opportunity is not open to you. Explore for opportunities that are.
refusals.application_not_editable: This application is already under review, so it can no longer change. Message the organization if something is wrong.
refusals.application_profile_share: The profile share on this application was revoked. Apply again to share your profile.
refusals.lifecycle_transition: That step is not possible from where this item is now. Reload to see its current state.
refusals.lifecycle_conflict: Someone changed this item a moment ago. Reload to see the latest, then try again.
refusals.representation_not_acceptable: Only the artist can accept a pending representation, and this one is no longer pending.
refusals.representation_expiry: Choose an expiry date in the future.
refusals.representation_scope_required: Choose at least one scope: Offers, Advance, Settlement or Documents.
refusals.representative_not_in_account: The named agent must be a member of your account. Add them to the team first.
refusals.profile_share_fields: Choose at least one profile field to share.
refusals.profile_share_engagement: You can share a profile only for an engagement you hold with that organization.
refusals.rating_engagement_not_complete: Ratings open when the engagement is Complete.
refusals.rating_immutable: Ratings cannot be changed once given. You can reply to a rating about you.
refusals.tin_format: Check the tax identifier: a W-9 needs nine digits; other forms need 4 to 30 letters and digits.
refusals.tax_form_payee: Companies file a W-8BEN-E and individuals a W-8BEN; either files a W-9 as a US person.
refusals.sod_self_grant: You cannot grant yourself a role. Ask another Account Owner or Admin.
refusals.account_role_band: Only an Account Owner can grant or remove Account Owner.
refusals.slug_taken: That web address is already in use. Choose another.
refusals.slug_reserved: That web address is reserved. Choose another.
refusals.cross_org_reference: That document belongs to another organization. Upload it again for this one.

help.title: Help
help.body: Questions about an engagement go to the organization that engaged you. Open Messages to reach them; they answer there.
help.account: Platform support helps only with your own account: sign-in, email and account deletion.

switchOrg.body: Pick the organization to focus on. Every organization you work with stays in Work and Messages.
switchOrg.empty: You do not work with any organization yet. Explore opportunities to start.

signIn.title: Sign in to Gateway
signIn.lead: Find work, get onboarded and get paid with one account for every organization.

signUp.title: Create your Gateway account
signUp.lead: One account works in Gateway, Atlas and Compass. Your profile stays yours.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a link to {email}. Open it on this device to continue.
checkEmail.bodyNoEmail: We sent you a link. Open it on this device to continue.

session.expiredBody: Sign in again to keep working. Nothing on this page is lost.

claim.title: Claim your submissions
claim.body: Forms and signatures you completed with a link sent to {email} can join this account, so you find them under Work and Documents.
claim.done: Your submissions are now in your account.
claim.nothing: No submissions were waiting for {email}. Anything you complete from now on is saved to this account.
claim.unavailable: Claiming is not open yet: the organization's token service has not connected to Gateway. Your completed forms are safe with the organization; ask them to resend the link if you need it.

errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password do not match. Check both, or use a sign-in link instead.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email first: open the link we sent you, then sign in.
errors.user_already_exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.weak_password: Choose a stronger password: at least 8 characters that are hard to guess.
errors.over_email_send_rate_limit: We sent too many emails to this address. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.over_request_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.provider_disabled: That sign-in method is not turned on for Gateway yet. Use email instead.
errors.link_invalid: This link expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.email: Enter an email address like name@company.com.
errors.password: Enter a password of at least 8 characters.
